description: Form 8995-A Part II, one column per business: three K-1 businesses totalling $600,000, single, taxable income before QBI $600,000 − $15,750 = $584,250, past the $197,300 + $50,000 range. Main ($100,000 not listed, W-2 wages $20,000): 20% = $20,000, wage limit max(50% × 20,000, 25% × 20,000) = $10,000 → $10,000. Business 2 ($300,000, no W-2 wages): $0. Business 3 ($200,000, W-2 wages $100,000): 20% = $40,000, wage limit $50,000 → $40,000. Total $50,000; the overall limit 20% × $584,250 = $116,850 does not bind. (One pooled business would have given min($120,000, 50% × $120,000) = $60,000.)
